name: PdfSpace
tagline: Read, edit and review PDFs — locally, in the browser or on desktop
summary: PdfSpace is a local-first PDF application built in C# with Uno Platform and SkiaSharp. The browser runs a real Uno WebAssembly app with the same document, editing and rendering libraries as the desktop host, and an Acrobat-inspired shell brings together tabs, comments, form preparation, native object and original-text editing, on-device OCR, AES-256 protection, redaction and page organization. No document or password is sent to a processing service.

highlights.title: Genuine Uno WebAssembly
highlights.text: The browser build is a real Uno/Skia application sharing its engines with the desktop host — not a PDF.js viewer or HTML canvas app.

highlights.title: Review without flattening
highlights.text: Highlights, notes, replies, ink, shapes, stamps and links are written back as native PDF annotation objects.

highlights.title: Prepare and fill forms
highlights.text: Create text, check-box and dropdown fields, fill imported forms, and import or export values as XFDF or JSON.

highlights.title: Edit native objects
highlights.text: Select native text, paths, images and Form groups on the page, then move, resize, align, group, crop or restyle them with one-step undo.

highlights.title: Real original-text edits
highlights.text: Replaces actual PDF text-showing operands instead of covering them with a white rectangle; unsupported cases are rejected.

highlights.title: Local Scan & OCR
highlights.text: Recognize image-only PDFs in English, Polish or German, review words against the scan, and export a searchable PDF.

highlights.title: Protect and redact a copy
highlights.text: Export AES-256 PDFs with separate opening and owner passwords, or build a confirmed image-only redacted copy.

highlights.title: Indexed performance
highlights.text: Indexed page geometry, bounded search indexes and bounded picture/source caches reduce repeated layout and parsing work on large documents.

items: Multiple document tabs for PDFs and editable workspaces
Search and copy text; zoom, pan and Ctrl+wheel zoom around the pointer
Continuous, single-page and two-page layouts with virtualized thumbnails
Original PDF outlines alongside editable workspace bookmarks
Local named destinations and internal links that follow page reorganization
Text, highlight, underline, strikethrough, notes and threaded replies
Ink, shapes, arrows, stamps and links
Move, resize and recolor annotations; resolve comments; undo and redo
Supported annotations and replies export as native PDF objects
Create text, check-box and dropdown fields directly on a page
Fill imported text fields, check boxes, radio groups and single-select choices
Edit tooltips, defaults, read-only/required/multiline flags, font size and maximum length
Import/export plain field values as XFDF or versioned JSON in one undoable transaction
Check required fields and Tab / Shift+Tab between supported widgets
Replace supported original text, including text inside nested Form XObjects
Select, move, resize, rotate, flip, replace, insert or delete native image placements
Align, distribute, crop, stack, group and copy/paste objects across documents
Edit real path geometry, control points and solid fill/stroke
Native opacity, blending, stroke caps/joins, miter and dash editing
Shift constrains movement and aspect ratio; Alt resizes from the center
Local recognition in English, Polish or German at 150, 200 or 300 DPI
Recognize image-only PDFs or import PNG/JPEG scans honoring EXIF orientation
Review low-confidence words against the original scan and correct them
Export a searchable PDF with an invisible Unicode text layer
Browser self-hosts pinned Tesseract.js/WASM models; native hosts use Tesseract 5
Reorder, rotate, duplicate, delete, crop, combine, extract and split pages
Export native PDF or a separately labeled flattened visual PDF
Download PNG, text, form data or an editable .pdfspace workspace
Browser recovery in IndexedDB; atomic temporary-file recovery on desktop
AES-256 revision 6 output with distinct opening and owner passwords
Print, copy and edit permission flags; owner authentication before re-editing
Browser encryption runs in an isolated, hash-pinned QPDF WASM worker
Raster redaction rebuilds every page as an image with burned-in marks

codeSamples.title: Build and run
codeSamples.code:
git clone https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/PdfSpace.git
cd PdfSpace
python3 scripts/fetch-assets.py
dotnet workload install wasm-tools

# Native engine and PDF round-trip tests.
dotnet run --project tests/PdfSpace.Tests -c Release

# Desktop host.
dotnet run --project src/PdfSpace.App -f net10.0-desktop -p:PdfSpaceDesktopOnly=true

# Browser publish and static-root collection.
dotnet publish src/PdfSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm -c Release \
  -o artifacts/publish -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/PdfSpace/
python3 scripts/collect-site.py artifacts/publish artifacts/site
python3 scripts/serve-site.py --directory artifacts/site --port 4173

playground.intro: Open the live WebAssembly build and try every workflow on the included original sample documents — no upload of private files needed.

tour.title: Browse the sample report
tour.text: Open the six-page Circular futures report, switch between continuous, single and two-page layouts, search with Ctrl/Cmd+F and jump via thumbnails.

tour.title: Mark it up
tour.text: Highlight text, add a note and a reply, draw ink or an arrow, then resize or recolor the annotation and undo with Ctrl/Cmd+Z.

tour.title: Fill the review form
tour.text: Open the interactive review form, Tab through fields, and use Prepare a form → Check required fields to find missing values.

tour.title: Edit native objects
tour.text: Choose All tools → Edit objects → Open object editing example; drag, Shift-constrain, align or restyle native text, paths and images.

tour.title: Run on-device OCR
tour.text: In All tools → Scan & OCR, open the scanned example, recognize the page, correct a word, then export a searchable PDF.

tour.title: Reorganize pages
tour.text: In Organize pages, drag thumbnails to reorder, rotate or extract pages, and export the result as a native PDF.

architecture.name: Model and geometry
architecture.text: Immutable workspace, annotation and field models, layout transforms and transactional undo — free of Uno, rendering and storage.

architecture.name: Parsing and rendering
architecture.text: PdfPig import and search feed a source-pinned Skia renderer with cached pictures, overlays and visual export.

architecture.name: PDF writing and recognition
architecture.text: A PDFsharp-backed structured writer, pluggable security provider and local OCR pipeline.

architecture.name: Uno controls and viewer
architecture.text: Custom Uno controls and an embeddable Skia viewport for pointer editing, forms and thumbnails.

architecture.name: Workbench
architecture.text: The multi-document shell composes the workflows; hosts inject browser or desktop storage contracts.

boundaries: Functional PDF workflows, not complete or pixel-identical Adobe Acrobat compatibility
Export PDF rewrites the document; it is not an incremental or guaranteed lossless save
No XFA, form scripts/calculations, certificate signatures, full tagging/compliance or Office conversion
Text editing has no paragraph reflow or complex-script shaping; unsupported encodings are rejected
Redacted output is image-only; .pdfspace workspaces are unencrypted and keep the full original
